reason: Non-packaged Electron cannot import the root better-sqlite3 binary in-process because the host Node ABI is 137 and Electron's embedded Node ABI is 130.

evidence.observedError: better_sqlite3.node was compiled for NODE_MODULE_VERSION 137 but Electron requires 130

decision: Source Electron E2E uses a fail-closed explicit host-Node child to execute canonical compiled dist without npx, tsx or shell
Packaged Electron remains in-process and ignores development-only switches
Both source Electron and packaged E2E remain mandatory complementary evidence
No native dependency rebuild is performed in the root because it would invalidate host-Node integration tests
